info.title: neuralguard
info.description: Detects vulnerable code in a pull request diff and confirms each finding with Claude.

options.name: --claude-model
options.description: Model that reviews the findings. Default: claude-opus-5.

options.name: --threshold
options.description: Confidence that sends a finding to review. Default: 0.6.

options.name: --block
options.description: Whether a confirmed vulnerability fails the run. Default: True.

options.name: --output
options.description: Also write the Markdown report to a file.
